title: EventDirector
description: The Best Plugin To Manage Events In Minecraft
body:
EventDirector is a simple, GUI-driven event management plugin for Paper that lets operators set a timer, configure PvP and worldborder behavior tied to that timer, show a custom title on finish, and display a customizable action bar countdown.

### What it does
- Creates a configurable event timer that displays a live countdown in the action bar with a custom label, then runs end-of-timer actions like re-enabling PvP, expanding the worldborder, playing a dragon roar, and optionally showing a title.  
- Provides an in-game GUI to toggle “PvP off until timer ends,” enable worldborder expansion with preset sizes, configure a finish title (color and style), and set a custom action bar label.

### Key features
- Timer set and start flow: set with duration, then start separately; live action bar countdown using a customizable label.  
- PvP control: disable PvP during the timer via GUI, auto-enable on completion, or force on/off globally via command.  
- Worldborder: default border set via command at the player’s position; optional fast expansion to a preset size on timer completion.  
- Finish visuals: optional title with color and plain/bold style, plus ender dragon roar sound on completion.  

### Commands (operator required)
- /EventDirector Timer <duration>  
  Sets the timer duration without starting it; supports formats like 30s, 5m, 1h.  
- /EventDirector Timer Start  
  Starts the previously set timer and begins the action bar countdown.  
- /EventDirector Timer Edit  
  Opens the main GUI to configure PvP-off-until-end, worldborder expansion, title options, and custom timer label.  
- /EventDirector WorldBorder <size>  
  Sets the default worldborder centered at the player; using 500 creates a 500×500 border at that location.  
- /EventDirector PvP on  
  Enables PvP in all worlds immediately.  
- /EventDirector PvP off  
  Disables PvP in all worlds immediately.

### GUIs (opened via /EventDirector Timer Edit)
- Main menu  
  - PvP Off Till Timer: toggles disabling PvP for the timer’s duration.  
  - WorldBorder Expansion: toggles expansion-on-finish and opens a size selector if enabled.  
  - Title Show: toggles showing a title when the timer ends; enabling adds “Edit Title.”  
  - Edit Title: set color (red, green, blue, yellow, cyan) and font style (plain or bold).  
  - Custom Timer Text: set the label used before the countdown in the action bar (default “Timer”).  
- Each submenu includes a red glass “Back” button to navigate to the previous menu.


### Timer completion behavior
- Re-enables PvP if it was disabled for the timer.  
- Expands the worldborder to the selected size over a short, configurable duration.  
- Plays the ender dragon growl for all players and optionally shows a configured title.

### Config (minimal)
- worldborder-expansion-duration: 60  
  Controls how fast the worldborder expands (seconds) after the timer ends.

### Notes
- All slash commands require operator status and affect the current server state immediately as described.  
- Worldborder “default” is set manually via command and is not altered when the timer starts unless expansion-on-finish is enabled.
